name: Diamond, the One-Eyed Treasury Magician
Abilities:

name: Gem Blade Onyx
Abilities: This card gains [Precision] as long as you control a darkness gem. (This card can attack recovered J/resonators).

name: Gem Blade Ruby
Abilities: This card gains [Swiftness] as long as you control a fire gem. (This card can attack and you can play its {Rest} abilities the same turn it enters the field.)

name: Gem Blade Sapphire
Abilities: This card gains [Flying] as long as you control a water gem. (This card cannot be blocked by J/resonators without [Flying].)

name: Gem Craftsman
